subject: Post-call: Novacorp pricing profile & context-length needs
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Malik <aisha.malik@novacorp.com>, Dan Liu <dan.liu@novacorp.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-09-14T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: Quick recap + next steps (pricing & token profile)

Hi Aisha / Dan — thanks again for the product deep-dive this morning. Short recap and the items we need to lock down to get pricing right: 

1) Usage profile (please confirm):
   - Monthly token volume: ~50M tokens (you said 30–70M depending on pilot traction).
   - Prompt -> completion mix (avg): prompt ~120 tokens, completion ~450 tokens per call (ballpark numbers you gave).
2) Context window needs:
   - ~94% of generation is within 8k window.
   - ~5% requires 32k (multi-document summarization flows).
   - ~0.5% are long-run analytical jobs that could need 128k (rare, batch).
3) Target unit economics: you mentioned a target of roughly $1,000 / 1M tokens for the hosted API during pilot (we should validate whether that is for net effective tokens or per-token billed).

Action items / asks from Novacorp to finalize scoping:
- Confirm average prompt/completion tokens by example endpoint (or a 24–48 hour sample).
- Confirm expected % of requests that must run on 32k or 128k windows versus 8k.
- Procurement: contact and expected PO timing so we can align billing and pilot start.

What we (Redwood) will do next:
- I’ll spin up a short cost model that shows per-variant cost (8k vs 32k vs 128k) with caching/batching assumptions and the effective $/1M tokens at three discount tiers.
- Karthik will propose a pilot configuration (model variants + telemetry + SLOs) so we can estimate token mix impact.

If you can confirm the sample data (or allow us to instrument a 48-hour test), we’ll put together a pricing worksheet and a one-page SOW for procurement.

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

Attachments: SOC2_report_Redwood.pdf (attached), SOW_draft_v1.docx (placeholder)
From: Aisha Malik <aisha.malik@novacorp.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Dan Liu <dan.liu@novacorp.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@novacorp.com>
Date: 2025-09-15T09:37:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick recap + next steps (pricing & token profile)

Thanks Ben — appreciate the clear write-up. A few clarifications after I synced with Dan and the ML team: 

- Monthly volume range: realistic pilot is 25–40M, production could reach 100M+/mo in 6–9 months. We should model both scenarios.
- Token averages: our telemetry shows historical averages of prompt 100–140 tokens, completion 350–600 tokens depending on persona. We'll extract a 48-hr sample and send it by EOD Friday.
- Context needs: your breakdown is right for us. For the 0.5% long jobs, we can schedule them as batch jobs if that reduces cost (we'll confirm).
- Pricing target: the $1,000 / 1M tokens is internal aspiration — procurement will push to get closer to $800 / 1M if possible. For the pilot they prefer a capped spend not to exceed $50k for the first month.

Procurement: we’re copied. Can you confirm SOC2 scope and any other compliance materials required for a vetted vendor? Also need a short SOW and a pilot success criteria doc.

Aisha Malik
Head of ML Products, Novacorp
aisha.malik@novacorp.com

Hi Ben — procurement here. A few items to move the pilot forward: 

- Please provide: latest SOC2 report, data processing addendum (DPA), and a brief SOW (1–2 pages) outlining pilot scope, timeline, deliverables and contact points.
- Billing preference: Novacorp requires Net 30 invoices issued to Novacorp Inc., VAT not applicable (US entity). PO likely to be raised in ~2 weeks after we sign the SOW.
- Pilot budget: aligned with Aisha — initial capped commitment $50k. If Redwood can provide a line-item estimate for expected token consumption per workflow that will help our PO.

Thanks — Procurement Team
procurement@novacorp.com

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Malik <aisha.malik@novacorp.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@novacorp.com>, Dan Liu <dan.liu@novacorp.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-09-18T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick recap + next steps (pricing & token profile)

Hi all — thanks for the quick responses and the data promises, this is helpful. Next steps from Redwood (what we'll deliver by next Tue 9/23):

1) Pricing worksheet (PDF) with three pilot scenarios: low (25M tokens), mid (50M tokens), high (100M tokens). Each scenario will show: gross $/1M tokens by model window (8k / 32k / 128k), estimated effective $/1M after prefix caching and expected batching, and a capped first-month estimate aligned to $50k pilot budget.
2) Short SOW (1–2 pages) for the pilot (scope, success metrics, timeline, contacts).
3) Compliance pack: SOC2 report (attached) and a short DPA template.
4) Proposal: recommended technical configuration — default to 8k model variant for interactive endpoints with automated fallback to 32k for the 5% flows and a queued batch path for 128k long jobs. Also include quantization recommendation to reduce per-token cost while preserving latency for interactive flows.

Internal note to Karthik (cc'd): once we have the 48-hr sample Aisha mentioned, run the sample through our cost model and produce: (a) estimated token mix by endpoint, (b) expected monthly spend at $1,000 and $800 / 1M tokens, (c) recommended deployment (hosted vs dedicated) and whether dedicated committed capacity makes sense at the 100M+/mo horizon. Please flag any items that would prevent us from keeping pilot spend within $50k.

Ben
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
